name: Building and Deploying AI in Pharma Manufacturing under GMP
description: A builder's course organized around specific GMP jobs, not "AI in pharma" in general: qualifying a deep-learning visual inspection recipe against manual inspection, running change control on that model after a camera or glass-supplier change, building multivariate CPV models and Raman/NIR soft sensors with out-of-model-space diagnostics, pairing process models with in-process testing as FDA's 211.110 draft expects, and assuring LLM summarizers, audit-trail analytics and review-by-exception flags inside validated systems. Every exercise uses synthetic data for fictional products.
fieldOfStudy: AI in Manufacturing and Industrial Operations

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Building and Deploying AI in Pharma Manufacturing under GMP

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 19 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
